authorization_evidence: Human user approved execution after the annotated next-calibration comparison/sample/full-budget request on 2026-10-27
budget_formula: 2 * calibration_N * calibration_steps / budget_steps * sum(case-wise max over budget worlds of measured end-to-end case wall or compressed artifact bytes)
recording: Full observations and selector diagnostics, lossless gzip level1; compression is file storage only, not wireless semantic coding
task_estimand: Mean paired control-treatment restricted completion_time=min(T,400), alongside completion/noncompletion/false-declaration counts
resource_estimand: ratio of arm means treatment/control for actual UL+DL and reserved logical CPU; measured process/wall reported separately
screen: Exploratory family gain CI lower >=3, both resource ratio family CI upper <=1.05, no undefined/degenerate endpoint; joint matched support separately requires both mean ratios in [.95,1.05]. All four predefined primary-method pairs required for eligibility for a future formal protocol, not confirmation.
failure_policy: Retain valid horizon censoring; software errors/timeouts abort and preserve records, never silently drop or substitute worlds. Incomplete matrices, zero resource denominators, nonfinite or degenerate distributions block positive screens.
scope: Exploratory new-world fixed-working-point calibration; not formal superiority, a full cost frontier, hardware deployment, live LLM or individual-message direct causal effect. Old GP-v2 No-Go unchanged.
